title: Pakistan would loose any unconventional war with India: Ex-CIA agent John Kiriakou
description: Former CIA officer John Kiriakou disclosed that the US feared a war between India and Pakistan in 2002 following the Parliament attack. He highlighted Pakistan’s support for terror groups and warned Islamabad about the consequences of conventional war with India.

title: Chamari Athapaththu blames defeats to India, England for Women's World Cup setback
description: Co-hosting the tournament along with India, Sri Lanka concluded their campaign after their last round-robin fixture against Pakistan was called off due to rain, a regular feature at this venue during the ongoing event.

title: India issues NOTAM for tri-services exercise along Pakistan border amid heightened tensions
description: India has issued a Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) for a large-scale tri-services exercise along the Pakistan border from October 30 to November 10, amid rising tensions following Operation Sindoor

title: Squeezed dry: Pakistan faces water war on two fronts
description: From Kashmir's glaciers to the Hindu Kush mountains, Pakistan's lifelines are becoming leverage. India suspended the Indus Waters Treaty, and now Afghanistan is building dams on the Kunar River, threatening to choke Islamabad's water supply.

title: India issues NOTAM for large-scale military exercise in Rajasthan and Gujarat
description: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh recently observed the exercise near the India-Pakistan border, where troops demonstrated advanced combat capabilities using robotic dogs, drones, ATOR N1200 vehicles, tanks, and helicopters.

title: India Issues NOTAM Alert For Tri-Services Exercise Along Pakistan Border From Oct 30
description: Satellite images showed NOTAM warning issued by India along the border with Pakistan, with the selected area and scale of operations described as unusual.

title: Asia Cup 2025 Hero Tilak Varma Reveals Team India 'Were Waiting At The Ground For One Hour' In Anticipation Of Trophy
description: Varma revealed that the victorious Indian side laid in wait for over an hour in anticipation of the silverware following their emphatic win over Pakistan in the summit clash.

title: Women's WC: Chamari Athapaththu Blames Defeats Against India And England For Sri Lanka's Group Stage Exit
description: Sri Lanka skipper Chamari Athapaththu reflects on World Cup errors and hopes for team improvement; Pakistan's Fatima Sana discusses weather impact.

title: Hockey India clueless about Pakistan's withdrawal from Junior World Cup, demand for neutral venue rejected: Report
description: Junior Hockey World Cup: Hockey India has revealed that they haven't received any information regarding Pakistan's withdrawal. | Hockey

title: India To Conduct Tri-Services Exercise Along Its Western Border With Pakistan Starting Oct 30
description: Earlier in the day, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh reviewed the security situation and the operational preparedness of the Indian Army in Jaisalmer. Chief of Defence Staff General Anil Chauhan, Chief of the Army Staff General Upendra Dwivedi, Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh were in attendance.
